title: Sunset Circuit – a small arcade racing game. Looking for honest feedback!
author: Baraboompa
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/qp9fotc0spxh1.png

  
Hi everyone! This is my first time making a small 3D arcade racing game. It runs right in your browser. No download or sign-up needed.

I made this with the help of AI. I came up with the ideas, decided the features and tested it, and the AI wrote most of the code.



Play here: [https://claude.ai/artifact/PjsMSXhMMxKVWodb4f3gyN](https://claude.ai/artifact/PjsMSXhMMxKVWodb4f3gyN)



What's in it:

\- 3 modes: Grand Prix (vs 3 AI rivals), Time Attack, Free Run

\- 6 tracks: desert, neon city, coastal causeway, moon surface, jungle, and an icy arctic track

\- Shift to drift, plus random item boxes (nitro, oil slick, shockwave)

\- Keyboard or touch controls, available in English / Korean / Japanese



Blunt feedback is very welcome. Thanks for playing!
